description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Eos' (End of Stream) task in a media playback system, specifically testing the behavior of setting end-of-stream signals in a GStreamer pipeline, handling underflow conditions, and ensuring correct interactions with mock objects.

classes.name: EosTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the Eos task, setting up mock objects and context for each test case.

methods.name: shouldFailWhenStreamIsNotFound
methods.description: Tests that executing the Eos task when no stream info is present does not cause errors.

methods.name: shouldSetEos
methods.description: Tests that the Eos task successfully calls gstAppSrcEndOfStream when stream info is available.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetEos
methods.description: Tests the behavior when gstAppSrcEndOfStream returns an error.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForAudioAndCancelAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Tests that the Eos task cancels audio underflow and sets EOS when audio stream info is present.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForAudioAndSkipCancellingVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Tests that the Eos task sets EOS for audio without cancelling video underflow if video underflow occurred.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForVideoAndCancelVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Tests that the Eos task cancels video underflow and sets EOS when video stream info is present.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForVideoAndSkipCancellingAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Tests that the Eos task sets EOS for video without cancelling audio underflow if audio underflow occurred.
